_comment: Source script for the complete React workflow shared with source Playwright acceptance. The owner approved this narration and its measured per-beat timing for capture. No final recording exists; exact frontend/backend proof runs and separate owner review of the rendered MP4 remain required.

segments.captionText: LastTake uses durable Strands interrupts so a script supervisor can pause a wrap workflow on its evidence and a first assistant director can resume it later. This capture starts with supplied records and no checkpoint result. The scene is synthetic; no crew trial or measured benefit is claimed.

segments.captionText: In Handoff, publish and reload the approved turnover. Download its manifest and prepare the wrap receipt. Handoff exposes the beat-to-take map, technical records, source digests and visible accepted exceptions for editorial review. Storage and event-bus acceptance do not prove delivery. Hashes identify bytes, not truth.
